title: Extra strange or bad dreams in Mallword
content: Are everyone's dreams in mallworld mostly good or mostly bad? Mine are mostly good, with only Maybe 1 or 2 I can remember that were downright nasty. Otherwise it's similar to what others have mentioned, that the dream scene is generally chill, but somehow unsettling in its vibe at times. My first actual bad dream in mallworld occurred the other night. (Side Note: This isn't meant to spook anyone out of Mallworld or anything, I just feel the need to express my concern regarding a bad dream there. Perhaps it can help others who have had that occur as well) I has running through a field of old wood cabins with other kids. There were screams heard in the distance. People over a certain age were being found dead, as if petrified/mummified mid stride or in place in their homes. Eventually we ran through the site into a lower level of Mallworld. It generally looked normal, a familiar area. Some cheap linoleum floors, a few tall escalators to upper levels, a tall glass atrium ceiling. But there were people shoving thier way through the crowd who were "infected". The only way to tell they were ill was that they had masses of green mold on thier faces and they had a perverted look of greed in thier eyes; like a look from them ran the risk of infection. Anyone else ever had a bad dream in part of mallworld? Is there a battle there going on the last few days, or just a particular section? Or is this just symbolic of the dangers of greed?
